items.headline:
MUNI YIELDS SURGE TO HIGHEST SINCE APRIL 2025

U.S. 10-year municipal bond yields jumped to 3.62%, the highest since April 2025, tracking the Treasury selloff.

JPMorgan says rising Treasury yields, heavy muni issuance and weak reinvestment demand are pressuring the market.

Absolutely incredible.
